notes: The Spirula command lines the worker runs for this version, mirroring the settings that gave the best Hemma dataset in Spirula Studio:
synchronized lenses, adaptive frame rate, blurry frames skipped, people masked with SAM 2.1 Base+ and Grounding DINO Tiny, depth and normals, then training.
{name} is filled in by worker.py; an item {?flag:text} is only used when that setting is on.
A new Spirula version gets its own copy of this file; check the flags against `spirula <tool> --help` of that version.

Checked against `spirula <tool> --help` of the v2026.11.12 Linux build. {@name} expands to several arguments: videoRigs = for each dual-fisheye video, --rig dual-fisheye=vN/cam0,vN/cam1, --sequence vN/cam0,vN/cam1 and --camera-model vN=thin-prism-fisheye.

licences: Spirula asks before it loads SAM 2.1, Grounding DINO, RoMa v2 (with Meta's DINOv3 licence) and FlexGlue. Nassau accepted these for the service on 2026-11-27; the cloud has no window to click Accept in, so every step passes --accept-license.
--eval-lpips 0: the quality score after training would download ~800 MB of extra weights on every run; the tour does not use it.
